citations.excerpt: But a council held at Moscow in 1666 approved the reform of Nikon , and pronounced its anathema against those who had not accepted his decisions.

facts.value: Opponents of Patriarch Nikon's revision of Russian service books and icons separated as the Old Believers.

citations.excerpt: the unappeasable hatred with which the “Old Ritualists” and the “Old Believers,” as they now began to be called, ever afterwards regarded Nikon and all his works.
summoned a properly qualified synod of experts to re-examine the service-books
